content.text:
=== .env (secrets redacted) ===
# Generated by scripts/create_secrets.sh. Do not commit this file.

# Shared local infrastructure secrets
DB_PASSWORD=<redacted>
S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=spark-local-4bc8b72f
S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=<redacted>
AUTH_SPICE_DB_TOKEN=<redacted>
KEYCLOAK_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD=<redacted>
LOCAL_KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET=<redacted>
OAUTH2_PROXY_COOKIE_SECRET=<redacted>
INJECTION_MODEL_TOKEN=<redacted>

# Browser-facing base URLs. Localhost by default, or https://<port>-$WEB_HOST behind
# a reverse proxy. Consumed by docker-compose.yaml (Keycloak hostname + oauth2-proxy) and
# process-compose.yaml (frontend). Regenerate .env after switching between plain-localhost and reverse-proxy setups.
FRONTEND_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:3000
KEYCLOAK_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:9090
S3_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:9000
TEMPORAL_UI_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:8233
OAUTH2_PROXY_COOKIE_SECURE=false

# Local Keycloak login user (seeded by the keycloak-bootstrap container)
LOCAL_USER_ID=790d3d75-2837-45f9-a200-6df1ffd1010d
LOCAL_USER_EMAIL=spark@example.com
LOCAL_USER_PASSWORD=<redacted>
LOCAL_USER_FIRST_NAME=Spark
LOCAL_USER_LAST_NAME=User

# External LiteLLM-compatible endpoint
LITELLM_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1
LITELLM_MASTER_KEY=<redacted>
LITELLM_TEXT_MODEL=spark-local-text
LITELLM_EMBEDDING_MODEL=spark-local-embeddings-1024
LITELLM_VISUAL_MODEL=spark-local-vision

# External Docling endpoint
DOCLING_PROTOCOL=http
DOCLING_HOST=localhost
DOCLING_PORT=5001
DOCLING_BASE_URL=http://localhost:5001
DOCLING_OCR_ENGINE=rapidocr
DOCLING_TIMEOUT=600
=== start docling pull (background) ===
docling pull started

observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== .env (secrets redacted) ==="
sed -E 's/(PASSWORD|KEY|SECRET|TOKEN)=.*/\1=<redacted>/' .env
echo "=== start docling pull (background) ==="
nohup bash -c 'docker pull quay.io/docling-project/docling-serve-cpu:latest > /tmp/docling-pull.log 2>&1; echo done > /tmp/docling-pull.done' &
echo "docling pull started"
